Activity 5: Escape Room Challenge
  - Description: Small teams work together to solve puzzles and uncover clues within a time limit to complete an escape-room scenario.
  - Objective: To strengthen communication, collaboration, and creative problem-solving under pressure.
  - Location: Local escape room or virtual escape-room platform
  - Date: To be scheduled
  - Time: 1–2 hours

Activity 6: Peer Appreciation Circle
  - Description: Team members take turns recognizing colleagues for specific contributions and sharing examples of helpful collaboration.
  - Objective: To build trust, reinforce a culture of appreciation, and improve team morale.
  - Location: Conference room or video meeting
  - Date: To be scheduled
  - Time: 30–45 minutes
